name: guardian-unit-penetration-testing-agent
description: A local security release gate that checks source and configuration before a vibe-coded app deploys.

interface.shortDescription: Stop risky deploys with a local security gate.
interface.longDescription: Scans source and configuration, optionally probes one explicitly authorized application URL, and returns a plain-language PASS, WARN, HOLD, or BLOCK release decision.
defaultPrompt: Check this app with Guardian Unit before I deploy it.
Explain and help me fix the security gate blockers.
Rerun Guardian Unit and tell me if deployment can continue.
